rounds.text: MIC Electronics is currently undergoing a significant growth inflection, evidenced by a 181% compounded sales growth over five years and a 160% increase over the trailing twelve months [E14, E16]. This aggressive expansion is supported by a robust capital structure, as the company maintains a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.14x [E31]. Notably, the company has successfully attracted institutional interest, with foreign institutional holdings surging from 0.00% to 20.36% since December 2023 [E36]. The business is also generating positive cash flow, with Rs 3 Cr in operating cash flow and Rs 1 Cr in free cash flow recorded in March 2026 [E29, E30]. While the market remains cautious, the company is positioned within a sector tailwind that supports its operational setup [E61]. Conceded: the company faces challenges with a -202% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E17], a decrease in promoter holding [E35, E50], and high debtor days [E52].
